_comment: x86Code Speed 18: optional features of the arm64 device. A device's features.json ({"features": {"id": bool}}) overrides the defaults; boot-a64.sh applies it at boot, tools/launcher (x86code-aot features, the GUI, the MCP server) edits it. A job is left out only when every feature listing it is off. Boot-critical jobs (MIN set, backboardd, SpringBoard, kbd, FileCoordination, sleepd, usernotificationsd) are never listed. cost_mb: PSS measured on a booted device (Speed 17/18 runs); when = boot (paid at every boot) or use (on demand: paid once the feature is used).

features.title: Wallpaper
features.desc: PosterBoard and the MercuryPoster extension (lock and home wallpaper). Off: black wallpaper.

features.title: Spotlight search
features.desc: The Spotlight UI process (home screen Search pill, pull-down search). Off: search shows nothing.

features.title: Keyboard
features.desc: InputUI (the on-screen keyboard service) and assistantd (dictation availability, shared with Siri). Off: text fields get no keyboard.

features.title: Siri
features.desc: Campo (the Siri UI angel) and assistantd. Off: the Siri app does nothing.

features.title: Maps services
features.desc: geod and navd (GeoServices, navigation). Off: Maps cannot load its map or search.

features.title: Photos services
features.desc: assetsd (the photo library) and its helpers. Off: Photos cannot open its library.

features.title: Files / FileProvider
features.desc: fileproviderd, the sim2host stand-in and DesktopServicesHelper. Off: Files shows only Recents.

features.title: Home screen widgets
features.desc: chronod, WidgetRenderer and the widget extensions (home screen widgets). Not on by default: about 750 MB more.
